What we do

Transport services

From a single bundle to a full truck, we book, carry and deliver with clear paperwork.

Parcel & part load

Bags, boxes, cartons, rolls and bundles booked and carried together with other consignments.

🚛

Full truck load

🏠

Door delivery

💬

WhatsApp updates

How it works

Four simple steps

1

Book

Bring your goods to us. We weigh them and record the consignor, consignee and charges.

2

Get your GC receipt

You get a printed GC receipt with its number, and a copy on WhatsApp if you share your number.

3

We transport

Goods travel by road on our trucks, listed on a lorry receipt so every consignment can be traced.

4

Delivered

Goods are handed over at the godown or delivered to the door, against a signed delivery slip.

Why Sabri Logistics

Transport done properly

Simple, traceable and well documented.

Proper paperwork

Every consignment gets a GC number and a receipt in three copies: consignor, consignee and driver.

Traceable

Bookings, lorry receipts, inward records and delivery slips are kept in one system, so a consignment can always be tracked down.

Careful handling

Goods are checked in on arrival and recorded, so anything missing is spotted straight away.
